sentences.text: 1.  We have heard the learned advocates for the parties.

2. This intra-Court appeal is directed against an interim order passed in the writ petition, wherein one of the directions was to grant provisional release of the goods subject to the appellant complying with the terms and conditions.

sentences.text: The learned advocate appearing for the appellant contended that the condition imposed in the order dated 19th January, 2024 is onerous as the appellant has been directed to pay a sum of Rs.45,64,860/-, which the appellant cannot comply with.

4. Be that as it may, the show-cause notice has been issued under Section 124 of the Customs Act,
1962 dated 22nd March, 2024.

In the said show-cause notice, there is a reference to the report submitted by the National Food Laboratory, Kolkata, which states that the sample did not conform to the standards laid down under Regulation 2.3.55 of the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products and Food Additive) Regulations, 2011.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products and Food Additive) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: If that be so, it is not clear as to how provisional release was granted.

In any event, since the show-cause notice has been issued and the appellant is unable to comply with the condition imposed by the department for provisional release, the best course open to the appellant is to respond to the show- cause notice.
Therefore, the show-cause notice is to be adjudicated.

5. In the light of the above, writ petition, appeal as well as connected application (IA No. CAN 1 of 2024) are disposed of by directing the appellant to submit his reply to the show-cause notice within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of server copy of this order.

On receipt of the reply,
the adjudicating authority shall fix a date for personal hearing and complete the adjudication and pass orders on merits and in accordance with law within a period of two weeks from the date on which the personal hearing is concluded.
7. Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be furnished to the parties expeditiously upon compliance of all legal formalities.
